briefing.summary: Holding short of runway 29R, ready for departure. Tower has just issued your takeoff clearance.

lastTransmission.speaker: atc
lastTransmission.text: Lima Echo Foxtrot, runway two nine right, cleared for take-off, wind two eight zero at ten.

challenge.expectedText: Cleared for take-off runway two nine right, Lima Echo Foxtrot.

elements.label: Runway
elements.hint: Runway number + side designator. 'Two nine right' — spell out digits.

challenge.explanation: MATS Part 4: takeoff clearance readback is the takeoff clearance + runway in use + callsign. Wind is not part of the mandatory readback.

refs.note: Source/access date 2026-06-09. Mandatory readback items — takeoff clearance and runway.
